pull.title: Fall back to the live x-web bundle when profile SSR returns 403
pull.body:
CI runners get a 403 from the profile SSR endpoint, so the upstream canary failed for reasons unrelated to X's rules.

This falls back to the live x-web bundle and records which path was used in the stamp.

- [x] canary passes on CI
- [ ] document the fallback in docs/CI.md
